detail.longDescription: The CrowdStrike outage explained: a Falcon update read a 21st field from a 20-value array in a Windows kernel driver and crashed 8.5 million PCs. # security # windows # devops # crowdstrike # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community CrowdStrike outage explained: 21 fields, 20 slots, 8.5M blue screens
